progress_note: front-end list closed: alerts (cadence + role bar + volume floor) and cross-device saved-role sync shipped
next_move: Owner: create the ALERTS KV namespace + bind it, add RESEND_KEY to Pages, add the four repo secrets. Until then alerts report 'not configured' and send nothing.
session_summary: Closed the last two front-end gaps as one feature. Alerts run off the board's own first_seen history, so a role appears in exactly one email; threshold is built as both a role bar and a volume floor. Identity is a mailed token, no accounts or passwords, and it carries saved-role sync with tombstones so a stale device cannot resurrect an unsaved role. Saved roles stay local by default - an unlinked visitor makes zero API calls.
